sentences.text:
THIS CRIMINAL PETITION IS FILED U/S.482 CR.P.C,
PRAYING TO QUASH THE FIR AND CRIMINAL PROCEEDINGS AGAINST THE PETITIONER IN CR.NO.347/2021 FOR OFFENCE P/U/S.498-A OF IPC REGISTERED BY THE RESPONDENT NO.1 DEVARAJEEVANAHALLI P.S., PENDING ON THE FILE OF THE HONBLE 11Th ACMM AT BENGALURU.

THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY,
THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER

The petitioner is before this Court calling in question proceedings in crime No.347/2021 for the offence punishable under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
2.
During pendency of the petition, both the petitioner and the complainant have settled the dispute in OS No.249/2021 by drawing up certain conditions of settlement.
One of the conditions is, closure of the present proceedings.

The condition in so far as the present lis reads as follows:
"The Defendant has filed Criminal Miscellaneous No.591/2021, under Section 125 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 seeking maintenance from the Plaintiff herein and the same is pending before the Hon'ble VI Additional Judge, Family Court,
Bangalore.

entities.text:
VI Additional Judge, Family Court,
Bangalore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The Defendant has also filed a complaint with the police and the same is registered as C.C.No.53936/2022 under Section 498A of the Indian Penal code,
pending before the XI Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate at Mayo NC:
2023:KHC:20468 Hall Bangalore.

As against the Interim Order passed in Criminal Miscellaneous No.591/2021, the Plaintiff has filed Writ Petition No.8330/2022 on the file of the Hon'ble High Court of Karnataka and has secured an Interim Order in the said proceedings which is pending.

The Plaintiff has filed proceedings under Section 482 of the code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 seeking to quash C.C.No.53936/2022 pending before the XI Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate at Mayo Hall, Bangalore.

11. The Defendant for self and for the benefit of the two daughters herein had filed a suit in O.S.No.25731/2018 against the plaintiff pending on the file of the Court of the City Civil Judge, Bangalore City, Bangalore seeking a Decree of Perpetual Injunction.

sentences.text: The plaintiff filed a Memo in the said proceedings to the effect that he would secure the possession of the property from the Defendant in accordance with law.
In terms with the said Memo the suit came to be decreed.

2 in O.S.No.25731/2018, the Plaint has filed a suit for injunction against defendant and children before the Family Court, Bangalore and the same is registered as O.S.No.361/2022, and pending for adjudication."

For the aforesaid reasons, the following:

The FIR and criminal proceedings in Cr.No.347/2021 for the offence punishable under Section 498A of IPC pending on the file of learned 11th ACMM at Bengaluru, stands quashed.

During pendency of the petition, both the petitioner and the complainant have settled the dispute in OS No.249/2021 by drawing up certain conditions of settlement.
The Plaintiff has filed proceedings under Section 482 of the code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 seeking to quash C.C.No.53936/2022 pending before the XI Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate at Mayo Hall, Bangalore.
11. The Defendant for self and for the benefit of the two daughters herein had filed a suit in O.S.No.25731/2018 against the plaintiff pending on the file of the Court of the City Civil Judge, Bangalore City, Bangalore seeking a Decree of Perpetual Injunction.
